title: Evaluation design
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for fair, pre-registered evaluations: arms, frozen sets with manifests, pass marks committed before runs, exact-match scoring, two runs per arm, cost per case and missed marks reported, with a worked example the validator recomputes.
boundaries: Pass marks are committed by a person before any scored run and never change afterwards.
Labels are readable only by the scorer.
Importing the pack writes nothing and enqueues nothing.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for fair, pre-registered evaluations

value.lets_workers: Run a fair, honest comparison: fixed arms, a frozen case set with a manifest, pass marks a person commits before any run, exact-match scoring, two runs per arm, cost per case, and missed marks reported as missed.

flow.when: First: question, arms, metrics and draft pass marks.
A person approves the marks before the first scored run.
Twice per arm, as separate attempts.

used_by: any measured comparison in another pack
provenance_notes: The method generalizes docs/evaluation.md in the shamash repository (arms, frozen set, pass marks committed before runs, exact-match scoring, two runs per arm).

nouns.title: Evaluation method: arms, frozen sets, pass marks before runs, exact-match scoring
nouns.category_reason: A reusable evaluation method with guardrails, generalized from an evaluation plan used in this ecosystem.

value.origin: Generalizes an existing evaluation plan: re-run fixed arms against a frozen set, score by exact match, run each arm twice and commit pass marks first. The source is named in the descriptor's provenance_notes.
steps: Write the question the evaluation answers in one sentence, and the decision it informs.
Define arms: a baseline and each change, one change per arm where possible, with exact models, prompts, tools and settings.
Freeze the case set before any arm runs: opaque case ids, a manifest of case and label digests, and the generator or source pinned.
Commit pass marks before the first scored run. A person approves them; they never change afterwards.
Run every arm twice on the full frozen set. Record cost and latency per case from actual usage.
Score by exact match against known labels with deterministic code; a model judge may grade only explanations, with a person spot-checking its grades.
Report every mark as met, missed or unknown. A missed mark is reported as missed with its diagnosis, never reworded into a pass.
rules: Case ids must not encode labels; the drafting and answering workers never see labels.
Errors and timeouts are scored as wrong answers unless the plan says to exclude them; exclusions are reported with counts.
Cost per case is null when any case's cost is unknown; report the known subtotal and the count of unknown cases.
Spread between the two runs of an arm above the plan's limit marks the arm unstable.
Changing a pass mark, the set or the scorer after a run starts requires a new evaluation version; old results stay as they were.

metrics_menu.accuracy_points: Share of cases answered exactly right, in points.
metrics_menu.recall_points: Share of positive cases answered with the positive label, in points.
metrics_menu.twin_fp_points: Share of negative twin cases wrongly given the positive label, in points.
metrics_menu.net_points: Recall minus twin false positives, in points.
metrics_menu.abstention_points: Share of cases held for review instead of answered, when the plan allows abstaining.
metrics_menu.cost_per_case_usd: Actual usage times dated price, divided by cases; null when any case cost is unknown.

nouns.title: Exact-match scoring procedure
nouns.category_reason: A zero-call deterministic procedure: the same predictions and labels always give the same scores.

inputs: The frozen set's labels, readable only by the scorer
steps: Verify that the run's set reference and the manifest digests match.
For each case, the prediction is correct only if it equals the label exactly; null or an error is wrong.
Compute the plan's metrics in points with three decimals; cost per case is null if any case cost is null.
Evaluate each pass mark across the arm's runs: met, missed, or unknown when a needed value is null.
checks: Scoring the same run twice gives identical output.
The worked example's recorded results are reproduced exactly.

nouns.title: SYNTHETIC worked example: two arms, two runs each, four pass marks
nouns.category_reason: A golden fixture: fixed cases, fixed predictions and the recorded expected metrics and mark results.

value.purpose: Shows the method's arithmetic end to end, including an error counted as a miss, a missed mark and an unknown cost. The validator recomputes it.

pass_marks.rule: A1's net points beat A0's by at least 25 in both runs.
A1's twin false positives are no higher than A0's in both runs.
A1's recall is at least 90 points in both runs.
A1's net points differ by less than 5 between its two runs.
A1 costs at most 0.02 dollars per case in both runs.

reading: M3 is missed because the error on case-08 counts as a wrong answer; it is reported as missed, not excused.
M5 is unknown because one case's cost was not recorded; the known subtotal is reported beside it.

verbs.title: Design the evaluation
verbs.summary: Turn a question into an evaluation plan: arms, metrics, runs per arm, scoring and draft pass marks for a person to approve.
verbs.outcome: A plan, one arm noun per arm and draft pass marks, or no_change when an existing evaluation already answers the question.

slots.name: question
slots.description: Pin of a noun stating the question and the decision it informs.

slots.name: prior_evaluations
slots.description: Pins of earlier evaluation reports on the same question.

steps: Verify the pins. State the question and the decision it informs in one sentence each.
Define a baseline and the fewest arms that answer the question, one change per arm where possible.
Pick metrics from the method's menu and say why each matters to the decision.
Draft pass marks with thresholds; they stay drafts until a person commits them.
Estimate cost per arm from dated prices and label it an estimate.
Propose a freeze-set verb, a commit-pass-marks verb for a person, and two run-arm verbs per arm to follow them.

acceptance.check: The plan validates against template.evaluation-plan's schema.
Exactly one arm has role baseline, and runs_per_arm is at least 2.
Every arm noun names an exact model identifier and a settings source.
The draft pass marks reference only arms and metrics in the plan.
The arms and metrics can actually answer the stated question.

verbs.title: Freeze the case set
verbs.summary: Hash every case and label into a manifest with opaque ids before any arm runs, and check that ids cannot leak labels.
verbs.outcome: A frozen-set manifest; labels stay readable only by the scorer.

slots.name: case_source
slots.description: Pin of the generator output or case collection to freeze.

steps: Verify the pins. Assign opaque case ids that carry no label, order or source hints.
Compute SHA-256 digests of each case input and each label; store labels where only the scorer can read them.
Put near-duplicates in one group and one split.
Record the generator or source pin and the freeze time.

acceptance.check: The manifest validates against template.frozen-set-manifest's schema.
No case id contains a label value, and ids sorted alphabetically are not grouped by label.
No two cases share an input digest.
Every group sits entirely inside one split.

verbs.title: Commit the pass marks
verbs.summary: A person reads the draft pass marks, changes them if needed, and commits them before any scored run.
verbs.outcome: Committed, immutable pass marks, or no_change if the person decides the evaluation should not run.

slots.name: draft_pass_marks
slots.description: Pin of the draft pass marks.

steps: Read the plan and the draft marks. Each mark should be something you would act on if it were met or missed.
Change thresholds if needed, then commit. After this, the marks never change for this evaluation version.
Commit before any run-arm task for this evaluation is claimed.

acceptance.check: The committed marks validate against template.pass-marks's schema with immutable true.
No run record for this evaluation existed when the marks were committed.
committed_by is human and the submitting key belongs to a person.

verbs.title: Run one arm once
verbs.summary: Run one arm over the whole frozen set exactly as defined and record every prediction, error, cost and latency.
verbs.outcome: A run record. Each arm runs twice, as two separate attempts with run_index 1 and 2.

slots.name: arm
slots.description: Pin of the arm to run.

slots.name: pass_marks
slots.description: Pin of the committed pass marks.

run_index.description: Which run of this arm, starting at 1.

steps: Verify every pin, and that the pass marks are committed and predate this claim; otherwise return blocked.
Run the arm exactly as its noun defines it: same model, prompt, tools, context and settings. Keep the caller's settings unless the arm says otherwise.
Never show case labels to the arm. Answer every case in the set; record errors and timeouts as they happened.
Record cost and latency per case from actual usage; unknown values stay null with a reason.
Stop at the arm's budget and record how far the run got.

acceptance.check: The run record validates against template.run-record's schema.
The record has exactly one entry per case in the manifest.
The pass marks were committed before this task was claimed.
The run used the arm's exact model and settings.

capabilities: the arm's provider access within the worker's own allowance
write candidate nouns in the requester's scope
network: Only the arm's declared provider destination.

verbs.title: Score one run
verbs.summary: Score one run record by exact match against the frozen labels with the deterministic scoring procedure.
verbs.outcome: A scored run with metrics; the scorer is the only worker that reads labels.

slots.name: pass_marks
slots.description: Pin of the committed pass marks.

steps: Reproduce the worked example's expected results first; stop with blocked if they differ.
Verify the label digests against the manifest before scoring.
Score exactly as the procedure says: null or an error is wrong; cost per case is null if any cost is null.

acceptance.check: The scorer reproduces example.worked's expected metrics and marks exactly.
Scoring the same run twice gives identical output.
Every label digest matched the manifest.

verbs.title: Write the evaluation report
verbs.summary: Report every committed mark as met, missed or unknown, with per-arm metrics, stability, cost per case and a diagnosis for each missed mark.
verbs.outcome: An evaluation report; missed marks stay missed.
steps: Verify the pins and that every arm has runs_per_arm scored runs; otherwise report the gap as unknown.
Copy metrics from the scored runs; do not recompute them differently.
Mark an arm unstable when its spread exceeds the plan's limit.
Give each missed mark a short diagnosis. Never reword a missed mark as a partial pass.

acceptance.check: The report validates against template.evaluation-report's schema.
Every committed mark appears exactly once.
Every metric equals the value in its scored run.
Each diagnosis points at a likely cause someone could test.

verbs.title: Review the evaluation
verbs.summary: A different worker rechecks the report against the scored runs, the committed marks and the method's rules.
verbs.outcome: Review notes, with any rule the evaluation broke.
steps: Confirm you did not write the report or score its runs; otherwise return blocked.
Recompute each mark from the scored runs and compare.
Check the method's rules: marks before runs, opaque ids, two runs per arm, nulls honest.

acceptance.check: Every mark's result matches a fresh recomputation.
The reviewing key differs from the report's and scorer's keys.
Each method rule is marked kept or broken with evidence.
